what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_diagnostics_receipt.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: compare_loadings(Lambda_a, Lambda_b)$R, the 2 x 2 orthogonal transform
cases.julia_source: GLLVModels.compare_loadings(A, B).R, as called at test/test_diagnostics_p1.jl:105
cases.note: Inputs: a 6 x 2 pair: the d = 2 fit's Lambda_B (Lambda_a) against the loadings the data were simulated from (Lambda_b), the use R's documentation gives; optimal transform a small rotation (about 0.5 degrees), residual Frobenius distance 0.120. Both engines receive the same doubles: the inputs are recorded in the fixture at 17 significant digits and read back by Julia, so the comparison is of the Procrustes computation alone (R: svd(crossprod(Lambda_b, Lambda_a)), R = v u'; Julia: svd(Lambda_b' Lambda_a), R = V U'). Matrices are compared entrywise (column-major order).
